faqs.question: What does SolCrys do?
faqs.answer: SolCrys shows how ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Claude describe your brand, finds the gaps against your Corporate Context, drafts the fixes for your team to approve, and reruns the same prompts to show what changed. With [SolCrys Sites](/sites/), we also plan, build and host the website itself.

faqs.question: What is AEO, and how is it different from SEO?
faqs.answer: Answer Engine Optimization makes a brand's facts, proof, and pages easy for AI systems to retrieve, cite, and summarize. SEO targets the results page; AEO targets the answer itself. [Read the full comparison of AEO and SEO](/aeo-vs-seo/).

faqs.question: Which AI surfaces should brands monitor?
faqs.answer: Start with ChatGPT, then add Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Claude as you scale — Pro tracks any 4 of these 5 engines and Custom runs all 5. Retail shopping assistants are a scoped add-on where they materially shape the category.

faqs.question: Can SolCrys track a local business?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose Local business when you create a workspace and add your city. The tracked prompts are asked the way nearby customers ask them ("best family dentist in Bellevue"), each engine is asked with your city as the user's location, and you see who gets named and which sites the answers cite. [See how local AEO works](/local-business-aeo/).

faqs.question: How is it priced?
faqs.answer: SolCrys has a free plan and monthly paid plans. The free plan covers ChatGPT with no credit card; paid plans add more engines, more prompts, and automatic tracking. [See plans and pricing](https://app.solcrys.com/pricing).

faqs.question: Does SolCrys build websites and booth demos?
faqs.answer: Yes. [SolCrys Sites](/sites/) plans, writes, designs, builds and hosts websites for technology companies, from the homepage to category pages, product pages and supporting articles. [SolCrys Motion](/motion/) builds booth animation and interactive demos that explain deeply technical products. Sites is scoped and quoted per website with hosting included, Motion per project, and both work from the same Corporate Context as SolCrys AEO.

faqs.question: What are SolCrys's data sources?
faqs.answer: For visibility measurement, SolCrys runs your tracked buyer prompts across supported AI engines and captures the returned answers, citations, brand and competitor mentions, and timestamps. API, SERP, and rendered consumer-surface captures are tagged separately. For prompt sets, each Golden Prompt Set is built from real demand signals: search demand, the questions people ask around it, and community discussion where available. Every measurement stays traceable to its prompt, engine, capture method, and time.

faqs.question: How does SolCrys keep AI-generated content brand-safe?
faqs.answer: Every action is grounded in your Corporate Context — approved facts, claims, and guardrails — and routes through human approval before it ships.

faqs.question: What is Answer Accuracy?
faqs.answer: Answer Accuracy grades each AI answer about your brand pass or fail against your Corporate Context — your approved source of truth — and shows exactly what an engine got wrong. Pro includes it on up to 15 prompts; Custom grades every prompt against a Managed Corporate Context.

faqs.question: How does SolCrys prove a fix actually worked?
faqs.answer: Before a fix ships, SolCrys records a baseline on the questions your buyers ask AI. After it ships, the same prompts rerun across the same engines, so you can see the change in mentions, citations, answer accuracy, and recommendation share.
